tool: Simulated scanner export (Field Agents training data)
note: Scanner output is a claim, not a verdict. Some findings and patches are wrong.

findings.title: SQL injection in user login
findings.description: The login handler builds its SQL statement by interpolating request fields into a template string.

findings.title: SQL injection in product search
findings.description: The search handler interpolates the q query parameter into a LIKE clause of a raw SQL statement.

findings.title: Open redirect through allowlist substring match
findings.description: isRedirectAllowed accepts a target if it contains any allowlisted URL anywhere in the string.

findings.title: SQL injection in product search fix
findings.description: A raw sequelize.query call on the Products table uses the search criteria from the request.

findings.title: Poison null byte in file server
findings.description: The file server's extension check can be confused by an encoded null byte in the requested file name.

findings.title: Code injection in B2B order processing
findings.description: Order lines from the request body are evaluated in a JavaScript sandbox that is not a security boundary.

findings.title: Hardcoded secret in source
findings.description: A 64-character hexadecimal secret is hardcoded in the repository.

findings.title: Server-side request forgery in profile image upload
findings.description: The server fetches an arbitrary user-supplied URL to download a profile image.

findings.title: Broken access control on baskets
findings.description: Baskets are loaded by the id in the URL without checking the basket belongs to the requesting user.

findings.title: NoSQL injection in product review update
findings.description: The review update builds its MongoDB-style selector from the request body, so operators in the body change which reviews match.

findings.title: Stored XSS in product reviews
findings.description: Review messages written by users are rendered in the product details dialog.

findings.title: XML external entity processing in file upload
findings.description: Uploaded XML is parsed with external entity expansion enabled.

patches.description: Parameterize the login query with Sequelize replacements.
Escape single quotes in the search term before it reaches the query.
